summary: Round 35 referral additions (milestones + weekly rewards + scan-to-register backend + poster style) tested end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_referral_round35.py (11 tests, all PASS); regression /app/backend/tests/test_referral.py (13 tests) still PASS — 24/24 total. Covers: GET/PUT /api/admin/referral/config round-trip for new fields (milestones_enabled, milestones[], weekly_enabled, weekly_rewards[]) with edited count=4/val=400 persistence then restore to defaults; POST /api/admin/referral/weekly/run → {ok:true}; GET /api/admin/referral/weekly/awards returns list; POST /api/cron/referral-weekly → 401 without Authorization, 200 {ok:true} with Bearer WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, duplicate X-Webhook-Id → {ok:true, duplicate:true}; GET /api/me/referral now includes milestones_enabled/milestones/milestones_granted and every poster has a style dict; poster create+update stores style (title_color/subtitle_color/code_color/align/title_pos/card_pos) and persists through list GET. Admin UI (/admin/login → TOTP → 運營管理 → 邀請返利) exercised with Playwright: 獎勵配置 tab shows all 3 sections (基礎 / ref-cfg-milestones / ref-cfg-weekly) with ref-cfg-ms-add / ref-cfg-wk-add / ref-cfg-wk-run / ref-cfg-save all present; adding a milestone row works; 儲存全部配置 shows success; 立即結算本週榜 fires without crash. 海報模板 tab edit modal (ref-poster-modal) shows ref-poster-preview with draggable title+card chips, 3 color inputs, align-left/center toggles, 儲存 button — color change + align-left + save round-trip verified via DB (first poster style persisted with title_color=#aabbcc / card_x,title_x etc.). 排行榜與週獎 tab shows both ref-lb-table and ref-weekly-table. Config and first poster style restored to defaults.

minor.issue: Seeded poster rows (created before the style field existed) returned without a 'style' key, forcing clients to defensively default it. Fixed in server.py (defaults to {} in the response loop) so Invite.jsx buildPoster(poster.style) is safe.
Legacy seeded poster '福氣紅' still returns style:null in admin list (no normalisation on admin side). Non-blocking because the admin editor opens null→{} client-side, but worth normalising for parity.

The parallel run order has a subtle gotcha: test_referral.py::TestReferralConfig::test_update_persists PUTs only {enabled,referrer,referee,poster_title,poster_subtitle} which — because ReferralConfigIn defaults milestones=[]/weekly_rewards=[] — wipes those arrays from the stored doc; the Round 35 suite always restores defaults at the end, so running them together leaves clean state.
